boundaries.subject: unit: nonnegative value rule; does not prove complete functional AC
boundaries.mock_boundary: No mocks; assert independent concrete expected values.
boundaries.isolation: JUnit method and @TempDir; negative validation does not prove filesystem integration

boundaries.subject: functional/integration: authorized update/read and rejected cross-owner write; owner parameter is fixture input, not production identity authentication
boundaries.mock_boundary: No filesystem mocks. Not Spring, HTTP, database transaction, or production authentication proof.
boundaries.isolation: JUnit @TempDir per test; cleanup only fixture-owned files

commands.purpose: From repository root, using the pinned Python environment. Replace both absolute paths with an absent output directory and verified dependency directory. Fixed script runs both stacks, captures actual commands/times/exit/environment; weakfix expected failure is a control, not a passing product test.
After fixed pilots, collect actual raw results into manifests/RTM; never substitutes for execution.

exclude: tests and test code; coverage-generated reports
coverage_policy.denominator: JaCoCo report includes compiled RecordStore.class and uncalled Untouched.class, with Java src source lookup; test classes excluded. Report measured LINE/BRANCH totals separately.
coverage_policy.risk_basis: No arbitrary percentage gate. Keep zero-hit code visible; exercise legitimate updates and rejected cross-owner changes. Filesystem roundtrip is a limited integration boundary. Code coverage never implies AC coverage.

reporting.raw_outputs: java.xml, java-reports/, java-coverage.xml, java-coverage-html/, java.log, java-receipt.json, javac/jacoco logs and receipts
reporting.policy: Output names are prospective under the caller-selected artifact directory, not claims that artifacts already exist. Preserve exact source/test/strategy content revisions, selectors, environment, exits, failure details and raw evidence. Same-target collection only; PARTIAL technical results do not make full functional TC/AC PASS or Owner acceptance.
reporting.scope: No API/component/E2E assertions in this fixture. No Spring/Maven/.NET/Go validation claim.

tdd_scope.applicability: New authorized fixture behavior or behavioral defect uses RED from expected missing behavior, minimal GREEN, relevant regression; preserve actual receipts and code/test revisions. Do not manufacture historical RED.
tdd_scope.historical_status: NOT_VERIFIED until actual representative RED/GREEN evidence is linked; strategy itself is not evidence.
tdd_scope.non_applicable: Prose/config changes need appropriate structural checks, not invented behavior tests; fixed Java fixture alone is not a claim of Java TDD.

data_privacy.data: Only synthetic alice/bob/r1 and numeric values; isolated temporary database/files.
data_privacy.forbidden: No PKMS business code/data, NAS, production databases, private files, credentials, daily browser profiles, merge/deploy/release actions.
data_privacy.retention: Keep only fixture-owned sanitized reports/logs; cleanup only own temporary paths. Never upload database files or secrets.

selection_basis: Use fixed JUnit console and digest-locked JaCoCo with JDK17 because Maven is unavailable; avoids a build service and proves non-pytest reporting. Spring Test/Mockito unnecessary for this filesystem fixture; no Spring runtime verified.
ci_policy: Synthetic experiment scope only, authorized by Issue29#6433745571 and bounded START_CODING evidence #6433602312; PROPOSED strategy is not Owner production architecture approval. CI should invoke the same fixed commands with Python3.12/JDK17 and verified dependencies, propagate unexpected runner failures and upload available diagnostics even on failure. No CI success claimed by this file; actual CI URL/status must come from run receipt. weakfix expected nonzero control must remain explicit.
